description:
The reference for the engine's full design language (the `blueprint` argument of generate_dataset,
    start_generation and validate_blueprint): roles, distributions, formulas that read parent columns
    and draw noise, per-group sequences (seq, lag, cumsum, ar1 drift, random walk), aggregates, event
    windows, cause-and-effect, lifecycles, with patterns, and an index of chapters. Read it before
    writing a blueprint.

    Args:
        topic: a chapter's id from the index (or several, comma-separated) for that chapter in full, with
            a world that builds as written: JSON payloads (webhooks, audit trails), threads of messages,
            one party's duplicate records, running balances, rosters made from demand, a source system's
            raw drops and schema changes, planted problems for an eval. Empty for the reference.
name: blueprint_guide
title: Blueprint reference
